items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: They was all in my band. So we had six pieces. I had Cooper and Fathead.

ctx.x: See, he was already kind of ill. But we didn't need him along with us, because Ray Charles was playing the piano, see -- so we didn't need him with the group. So we had six pieces. I had Cooper and Fathead. They was all in my band. So Ray had that tour, and he wanted me to make up the six pieces, just have six pieces along, and we played them dates. So we had to come back through here and go to Tulsa and play the next night. I come on home... I made it back. And then we were going to lay off for a week or so, so…
And you've stayed with it ever since.

items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: What was the name of the big band that went up to Omaha... Big fat boy who played...

ctx.x: No, they had a pretty big band. And Red Calhoun started out for a little while, I think, had a little small band. But mostly all the bands... And, like, uh... What was the name of the big band that went up to Omaha... Big fat boy who played...
